cafe.name: La salle du café · Café Room
cafe.alt: Inside the village café's dining room, painted in ink and gouache: a tabby cat dancing on a little round marble table beside grandma laughing in her chair, a little girl driving a red go-kart carrying the menu, an old waiter writing a bill that curls down toward the floor, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret raising a finger to order, the young waiter swerving with two plates of croissants and a boar in patched overalls dropping a coin into his cup; the glazed door on the left leads out to the village, the open double door at the back leads to the terrace and the stone archway on the right leads to the bar.

doors.label: La terrasse
doors.hint: Out through the open double door to the terrace

doors.label: Le bar
doors.hint: Through the stone archway to the bar

bar.name: Le bar du café · Café Bar
bar.alt: The café's zinc bar counter, painted in ink and gouache: a green boa singing with a pink lemonade, Monsieur Verbe in a gold beret gulping a huge glass of water, Monsieur Verbe in a gold beret sitting down on the last free chair and admiring himself in a hand mirror, a ginger cat on the counter by a cup of tea, a little boy kneeling on the floor biting a giant sandwich that pours out sand and a baby giraffe leaning over a tall glass of orange juice with a straw standing on the counter, with the café's treat shelves on the wall above the counter; the stone archway on the left leads back to the dining room.

doors.label: La salle
doors.hint: Back through the stone archway to the dining room

zooms.label: Les étagères
zooms.hint: Look closely at the shelves above the bar counter

comptoir.name: Les étagères · Counter Shelves
comptoir.alt: A close-up of the shelves above the café bar counter, painted in ink and gouache: a laughing little boy in an apron tossing a cup of coffee into the air, a napkin folded into a swan beside a little bell, a sleepy man in a striped nightcap hugging a cup of black coffee, a croissant under a glowing crescent moon, three scoops of ice cream in a tall glass, a kitten asleep in a breakfast bowl and a glass of water shading its eyes.

terrasse.name: La terrasse · Terrace
terrasse.alt: The café terrace on the village square, painted in ink and gouache: a plant watering itself with a little can, an apple in a pom-pom hat, a stack of pancakes with a pink crepe-paper bow, glasses with crescent-moon lenses, Monsieur Verbe in a gold beret with deer antlers saying something kind under a heart bubble, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret raising his hand under a question-mark bubble, the sun lounging in a deckchair, a beach ball on a string, a red bike speeding off in a puff of dust, a little blue van puffing out a gust of wind, a dapper straw hat with a monocle and mustache, Monsieur Verbe in a purple beret crouching by the fountain pond answering a frog, and a round table with a checked cloth; the purple door on the left leads back inside.

doors.label: La salle
doors.hint: Back inside through the purple door

zooms.label: La table
zooms.hint: Look closely at the terrace table

table.name: La table · Terrace Table
table.alt: A close-up of the terrace table on the sunny cobbled square, painted in ink and gouache: the checked tablecloth curled up in a nightcap taking a nap, a salad bowl wearing a lad's flat cap, a pie with a striped straw stuck in it, a kitten holding up the menu, a dove perched on a knife and a cup of hot chocolate with a zap and a music note.
